I recently bought my Kia Seltos from Kia Autobahn, Prabhadevi, and honestly, my experience turned out to be much better than what I had expected after reading some of the Google reviews. I feel like what really makes or breaks the experience is the person you deal with.

In my case, I was assisted by Sapna and one of the managers, Gaurav. The whole process felt smooth and transparent from start to finish. Sapna was especially great to deal with—very patient, professional, and easy to talk to. She explained everything properly without rushing through anything and, most importantly, never pushed me to buy unnecessary add-ons (which is something you usually expect in this industry).

She did suggest a few accessories, but in a very genuine way—explaining why certain things are better if taken directly from the company instead of aftermarket. It didn’t feel like a sales pitch, just honest advice. I genuinely feel she’s a big asset to the showroom.

I also happened to meet Mr. Ravi, the VP, who helped speed up my delivery. Thanks to him, I got my car without any delays.

After delivery, I did face a small issue with the ceramic coating. But again, what stood out was how it was handled. Gaurav personally called me and offered to redo the entire work in my presence, which I really appreciated. That’s the kind of service you expect from a brand like Kia.

Overall, I had a really good experience with Kia Autobahn, Prabhadevi. If you’re planning to visit, I’d definitely suggest connecting with Sapna directly—you’ll save yourself a lot of time and hassle. I can personally vouch that she’s genuine and doesn’t play typical sales tricks

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Sir / Madam,

This is my sixth email regarding the repeated issues faced with my newly purchased Kia Sonet. While there have been verbal discussions, I have not received any proper written response so far, which is extremely disappointing.

The recurring issues have been ongoing since November, from the date of purchase of my new vehicle. The continuous breakdowns and repeated battery failures have caused significant inconvenience and mental stress. This situation is now seriously affecting my peace of mind, as I purchased a new car expecting reliability and safety.

Recently, I was informed by the service team that both the accessory screens (2 Nos.) and the ambience light installed in my vehicle have been removed and sent back to Kia Showroom Prabhadevi. Additionally, I have been verbally informed and committed by Kia India that in case any further major issue occurs in my vehicle in the future, the showroom will refund the full car purchase amount (not a single rupee less) that I paid at the time of purchase. I request written confirmation of this commitment at the earliest.

While I acknowledge these assurances, I must formally express my serious concerns regarding the following:

Repeated battery failure in a brand-new vehicle.

Installation of accessories that resulted in continuous technical problems. I was not informed by Kshitij Pandav that installing these accessories could lead to battery drainage or related issues. Instead, I was strongly encouraged to install additional accessories without proper disclosure of potential risks.

Extremely poor customer support and absence of written communication.

Unprofessional conduct and lack of responsiveness from the concerned Sales Executive.

Despite multiple emails, I have not received even a single proper written response. This raises serious concerns regarding customer service standards and escalation handling processes.

Further, I wish to formally lodge a complaint against Mr. Kshitij Pandav. He has not responded to emails nor to messages in the WhatsApp group created by the service center. There has been a clear lack of accountability and professional support from his side.

At the time of purchase, I was strongly encouraged to install additional accessories without being properly informed about possible consequences such as battery drainage or technical complications. It is the responsibility of a sales representative to transparently guide customers regarding:

Suitability of accessories

Possible risks involved

Long-term impact on vehicle performance

Unfortunately, this responsibility was not fulfilled.

I therefore request:

Written confirmation of the full refund process for the removed accessories.

Written documentation of the commitment regarding full vehicle refund in case of any future major issue.

A formal internal review of the conduct of the concerned Sales Executive.

Immediate improvement in communication and escalation management.

This entire experience has been extremely stressful and disappointing for me as a customer who invested in your brand with complete trust. I expect an urgent and formal written response to this email.
